EBOOT variant guessed solely by total file size then fixed offsets/count/name pointers used; no file digest/version signature or explicit count/name-string/target-archive span budget. Duplicate names receive generated suffix via linear filenames list, not preserved archive identity. No binary input opened during audit.

Nonstop validates lower bound4+60*count bytes but not exact trailing size/magic value or target script indices. Unsupported line types logged then retained in lines, serializer reverse lookup assumes known map and can fail. Repeated file IDs append same ScriptFile objects, with last assigned metadata shared across appearances. Game-specific speaker fixes applied in code; metadata is not source-byte identity.

Nonstop load mutates filename/script_pack before parsing completes, no transaction/complete indicator; invalid filename returns retaining prior state. Save directly rewrites binary. Source inspection only, no game runtime or input transformation executed.

Logger widget fully read, separate LGPL notice. Python logging handler holds weak widget reference and emits Qt signal instead of directly appending text; widget log protects state with QMutexLocker and inserts plain text. Actual thread/Qt signal delivery not tested. Direct convenience methods still call log synchronously, so mutex alone is not proof of GUI-thread ownership.

No maximum block count, byte limit or bounded pending-signal queue declared; prolonged logging can grow document/event backlog. messageLogged signal emitted while mutex held, so synchronous reentrant consumer can deadlock if it calls log. Source-level risk only; no reentrancy/runtime reproduction. Handler removed on close only if clearOnClose true. No logs/UI messages emitted to external user apps.

Entire setup wizard fully read in two bounded ranges. Initial ISO check verifies expected filenames only; executable check recognizes ELF prefix rather than complete format/version. Existing workspace outputs may be replaced before all stages finish. Threaded extraction/copy joins do not propagate worker failure as explicit setup failure; next stages can proceed. No wizard/runtime/file operation executed.

Wizard temporarily replaces process-global stdout and repeatedly swaps buffer while worker writes, without finally restoration; progress based on printed lines rather than verified output inventory. Graphics conversion deletes source intermediates even if converter merely logs failure; cancel can leave partially copied graphics. Renaming uses unsorted glob list mapped to fixed ID array, so mapping order depends on enumeration.

Final config saved after stages but no digest/schema/completeness validation of prepared duplicate/similarity DB. Editor ZIP and nested graphics container processing visible in source only; archived payload review remains structural and none decoded/extracted during this step. New terminology file created empty without CSV header. No source libraries/code adopted.

Last three large files lexically inventoried with Python3.12, no full reading credit. Python3.15 tokenizer rejects legacy ur prefix; source unchanged. Main editor, renderer and executable patch tables remain explicit manual followups. All178tracked parent blobs assessed with mixed methods, not full manual completion.

Selected complete saveChanges method read: propagates changed scripts across stored groups without fresh content/stability confirmation. Multiple changed members may overwrite same destinations sequentially; backup second-resolution, direct writes, no atomic multi-file commit/conflict receipt. No save/patch/render executed.
